```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")
```

For each Exomiser run, count how many manually confirmed gene / participant
pairs are found within the top *N* ranks (*N* = 1–30). The counts are used by
`03_benchmarking_figure_2A.Rmd`.

## Settings

```{r settings}
max_rank_checked <- 30

# my_run ("SKSC_3_MAF1per") is also the ESTABLISHED run in steps 2-6.
my_runs <- c(
  "SKSC_3_MAF1per_herIncluded_onlyKS",
  "SKSC_3_MAF1per_herIncluded",
  "SKSC_3_MAF1per"
)
```

## Manually confirmed KS gene / participant pairs

```{r manual-genes}
genes_john <- read_manual_genes()
```

## Counts per rank, per run

```{r process-runs}
process_run <- function(run) {

  all_vars <- read_exomiser_run(run) %>%
    maybe_remove_genes() %>%
    filter(EXOMISER_VARIANT_SCORE > var_score_cutoff,
           EXOMISER_GENE_PHENO_SCORE > pheno_score_cutoff_benchmark)

  message(run, " -- participants after score filtering: ", n_distinct(all_vars$Participant_ID))

  # Best Exomiser rank of each manually confirmed gene / participant pair
  manual_ranks <- all_vars %>%
    inner_join(genes_john, by = c("Participant_ID", "GENE_SYMBOL"),
               relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    best_rank_per_gene()

  message(run, " -- pairs found: ", nrow(manual_ranks),
          " (", n_distinct(manual_ranks$Participant_ID), " participants)")

  # Number of pairs found within the top N ranks
  counts <- tibble(
    rank = seq_len(max_rank_checked),
    n    = map_int(rank, \(r) sum(manual_ranks$RANK <= r))
  )

  write_delim(counts, counts_file(run), delim = " ", col_names = FALSE)
  counts
}

all_counts <- my_runs %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(process_run) %>%
  list_rbind(names_to = "run")
```

```{r counts-table}
all_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = run, values_from = n) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```
